joint_selection_audit.reason: Both SEAL_TIME_64 (40 hits) and SEAL_TIME_FUND_66 (52 hits) failed primary validation threshold (> 52 hits). Ties/failures resolve in favor of Frozen Baseline (52 hits, non-one-price 48 hits).

falsification_synthesis.hypothesis: Intraday first-seal timing and reported close-seal quotes improve full-date first-close Top-1 promotion beyond frozen 62-field model.
falsification_synthesis.falsification_finding: Decisively falsified. Adding first seal time alone (64 fields) skews selection toward fragile early-morning speculative pumps (loss of 18 baseline hits, net -12). Adding closing seal quote (66 fields) restores 17 hits but simultaneously drops 17 other sound picks (net 0 on primary, net -7 on non-one-price).
falsification_synthesis.attribution_clarity: The divergence between 40 and 52 is an empirical property of the feature information content (time-only vs time+closing funds), not a difference in agent reasoning capability.
